Id.run do
    let mut set := HashSet.emptyWithCapacity
    for x in nums do
      set := set.insert x

    let mut maxLen := 0

    for x in nums do
      if !set.contains (x - 1) then
        let mut curr := x
        let mut length := 1
        for _ in List.range nums.length do
          if set.contains (curr + 1) then
            curr := curr + 1
            length := length + 1
          else
            break
        maxLen := Nat.max maxLen length

    return maxLen
